༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub mchod kyi yi ge bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub mchod kyi yi ge bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rje btsun phag mo don grub ma'i mchod chog byed par 'dod na/ 'og gzhi dkyil 'khor pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi/ lte bar chos 'byung dmar po/ mtha' skor rdo rwa me ri byung na legs/ ma grub na mu khyud sngon po gcig gis bskor/ der mañji la thod pa chang gis bkang ba dang*/ de'i steng du me long la chos 'byung rkyang pa/ phyi rol phyogs bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje re/ dbus su hrī: zur gsum gyi nang du/ oṃ ā:hūṃ 'bri ste/ sin+dhu ra 'i dkyil 'khor yin/ gzhan shoms rnams zhal gnyis ma dang 'dra/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha nas brtsams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs zhu 'bul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams kyang zhal gnyis ma'i skabs bzhin/ nang mchod sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me zhes pa nas oṃ ā:hūṃ? lan gsum/ bdud rtsi'i dbus su chos 'byung gi lte bar hrīḥ zur gsum la g.yon skor gyi oṃ hūṃ ha/ de'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dang*/ khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ bdag dang gnas la bdud rtsi gtor/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+tan hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khro mo dang khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs rnams thams cad tshar bcad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du srung ba'i 'khor lo grub par gyur/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo nas/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo rnams kyis rgyas btab par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa= oṃ badz+ra shud+dha= oṃ yo ga shud+dha= stong pa'i ngang las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ kha dog dmar po/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan cing*/ gdengs ka rgyas pa gyen du phyogs pa/

phyi'i phyogs bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa/ dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pas bskor ba de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar/ 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i mi ro ser po mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa/ khams gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi snying gar/ rang sems hrīḥ yig dmar po bskal ba'i me ltar snang ba/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo thun mtshams kyi dmar ba lta bu'i sku mdog can/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim rgyas pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma dang dbugs bral gyi gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i gyad kyi dor stabs kyis sa gsum gnon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum/ me ltar 'bar ba'i sdang mig can/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ drag mo chen mo 'jigs su rung ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro can/ phag gi gdong pa can/ shin tu khros pa'i zhal rdo rje'i me 'od mnga' zhing ljags skyod pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'khyil ba/ ba spu dang mchan khung dang*/ gsang ba'i spu gyen du langs pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dpral bar brgyan cing*/ khrag 'dzag mi'i mgo bo'i do shal sku la 'chang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba/ gnyis pas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar gtod cing*/ gnyis pas gdug can ma lus pa sdigs par byed pa'i sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pas/ bsgrub bya 'ching bar byed pa'i rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ mchan khung du thabs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po bsgreng ba/ gdug pa can thams cad kyis bzod par dka' ba'i gad mo dgod pa/ bskal ba'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ yo ga shud+dha= gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ baṃ

nas tsan+ṭi kā'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ lte ba'i hrīḥ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal nas khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ rang sngags nas/ yar lud pa las rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /phyi ma'i bar gyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī ā be sha ya sarba duṣ+tan hrīḥswā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bā rā hī zhes pa nas/ brtan par mdzad du gsol gyi bar yang 'dra/ bdag bskyed kyi khyad par ro/ /mdun bskyed sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan lnga'i bar zhal gnyis ma dang 'dra ba las/ dkyil 'khor 'og ma'i skabs gzhal yas khang zhes pa dor/ bar pa'i skabs de rnams kyi dbus su hrīḥzhes 'don pa spo/ dkyil 'khor steng ma sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ni bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi steng du/ chos 'byung gru gsum pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can gyi nang gi dbus kyi cha la hrīḥ zur gsum la g.yon skor gyi oṃ āḥhūṃ/ phyi rol phyogs bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa bzhi ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi gnas su gyur pa'o/ /de ltar rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin/ sku gsum rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum po de thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa kha dog dmar po zhes pa nas sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ rang sems zhes pa dang */ bdag nyid ces pa dor ro/ /gong bzhin ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/

/bzlas pa cung zad sum+bha yang ci rigs pa bzlas/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan bdun brjod/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo don grub ma'i lha tshogs zhes pa nas/ gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar du gsol ba btab pa/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu blang ba rnams zhal gnyis ma'i skabs dang khyad par med de/ gtor ma rnams sum+bhas bsangs nas/ gsol bar gyur gyi bar/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī/ a be sha ya/ sarba duṣ+tan hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa la/ oṃ hrīṃ haṃ haṃ he he ha ha hi hi/ phaiṃ phaiṃ zha ེ sa btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du nas/ kun 'grub shog gong ma'i bar/ oṃ kha kha nas kun 'grub shog / 'og ma'i bar/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang*/ bum sgrub kyang 'dra ba las/ yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i ces pa nas rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī/ sogs snying po dang*/ sum+bha ci rigs pa bzla ba ni khyad par ro/ /bdag 'jug gi skabs/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sum+bha bzla ba'i bar/ lte bar oṃ baṃ nas / dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa nas/ smras nas dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig nas/ oṃ ā hri hri swā hā 'i bar/ tiṣ+ṣa badz+ra nas/ mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur/ 'og gzhi chos 'byung ni/ zhes pa nas/ sku gsum gyi ye shes so/ /rdo rje rgya gram bzhi 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ /yig 'bru rnams nas ye shes dang yon tan rgyas pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pas ma gos pa nas zung du 'jug pa'o/ /zhal gcig phag gi zhal ni rtog med de bzhin nyid du chos thams cad ro gcig pa'o/

/phyag bzhi ni sku bzhi brnyes pa'o/ /rdo rje ni ye shes te nyon mongs pa 'jom pa'o/ /thod pa ni bde ba skyong ba'o/ /lcags kyu ni 'khor ba pa rnams thar par 'dren pa'o/ /zhags pa ni gdug pa can rnams 'ching ba'o/ / thod skam lnga ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'o/ /zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /skra gyen du brdzes pa ni yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba'o/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni nas snang ba 'phro ba'o/ /de thams cad rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ / dngos gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje nas/ sprul sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs so/ / zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ oṃ gsum ma'i dod du 'di nyid kyi snying po bzla/ khyod zhabs pad+mo nas/ ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur/ gyi bar yang 'dra ba las/ oṃ gsum ma'i dod du 'di nyid kyi 'don pa spo/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i baṃ yig las zhes pa nas 'jug par gyur cig 'di la'ang sngags 'don pa spo puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar ro/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa nas bsod nams 'di yi sogs lhag ma mchod pa kha gso nas/ bkra shis kyi bar la'ang khyad par med de/ snying po 'don pa spo ba tsam bya'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs cho ga'i yan lag rnams kyang 'dra ba la/ /tshogs phud 'bul ba'i skabs thog mar 'di nyid kyi gtor sngags kyis 'bul dgos so/ /de ltar na rje btsun rdo rje phag mo bden gnyis zhal can gyi cho ga bde chen dpal 'bar la 'don pa bsgyur te/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo don thams cad yongs su grub pa'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga bde blag tu grub pa 'di yang*/ deng sang gi bla rul rnams las/ dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal chen pos khyad par du gyur pa/ tā ra nā thas blo dman mig phug lung rgyus kyang mi shes pa rnams kyi don du smras pa'o//
//ha ha// zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje btsun rdo rje'i phag mo don grub ma'i sgrub mchod kyi yi bzhugs/ - PAGE 184 -- PAGE 183 -- PAGE 180 -
